title: Villagerified Witch
description: This resource pack made the witch look more like the villagers, along with the spawn egg
body:
This makes the witches look more like the villagers.

This will also include the spawn egg to look the same
![Witch Spawn egg](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/aef264c1ecfa296c5113b5884acfee27e5ae7177.png)

The eyes of the Witch will be split into two colors which is the original color as well as the villager's color
![eyes](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0e231983f10e3cdb757ccad3032f8d001d40161b.png)
